## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or component

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:contracts` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and tests were added or updated for the change
- [ ] `npm run api:snapshot:check` passes (run `npm run api:snapshot` and commit the result if the public API changed on purpose)
- [ ] `npm run release:check` passes
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated (`docs/`, `examples/`, component catalog entries)
- [ ] Accessibility was considered: roles, labels, states, touch targets, reduced motion
- [ ] A changeset is added for user-visible changes, or the semver impact (patch, minor, major) is described below
